interruption_boundaries: after owner admission, before Rust prover
after coordinator metadata file sync, before metadata set completion
after candidate sealing, at first worker startup lock sync
limitations: Coverage begins after the controller has durably prepared the launch intent and resource plan.
Bootstrap interruption while recovering an already-existing proof journal still fails closed; it cannot be treated as an empty new candidate.
Automatic supervision/replacement, resource exhaustion, active reorg/stale results and all-worker failure remain open.
Matched repetitions, larger counts, complete timing boundaries, full-size CPU proving, returned Mac results and the two-hour pilot remain open.
missing_accounting_scope: The five SIGKILL owner cgroups disappeared before final accounting. Their telemetry and persistent fleet counters remain retained. Never-started GPU services have no accounting.
planner_fix: The worker launch directory now comes from the same execution origin as coordinator recovery; unfinished new candidates use their new journal.

retained_failures.reason: The initial planner retained the abandoned launch-store path for a new journal. Command validation rejected it before GPU reservation or proof acceptance. The corrected continuation and original partial journal are retained.
The smoke observer checked stopped state immediately after marker publication. The repaired observer waits for SIGSTOP; it observed D then T and confirmed unchanged bytes and child exit.

scope: New-candidate coordinator bootstrap only; all partial and failed journals remain retained. Initialized runs use ordinary journal recovery. Interrupted initialization while recovering an existing journal, controller pre-admission, resource exhaustion, reorg, all-worker failure, supervision and complete throughput gates remain open.
timing_boundary_note: The final resumed phase creates four recursive proofs from retained wallets, audits the root and applies one isolated count-four block. Prior bootstrap attempts and wallet/registry preparation are outside this phase; it is not a complete cold/post-seal or sustained-throughput result.
